destination.title: Ultraviolet consistency, field range and primordial cosmology
destination.question: How do specified ultraviolet assumptions, field-space restrictions, fluctuation dynamics and cosmological histories affect primordial predictions and the consistency of accelerated or alternative cosmological evolution?
destination.summary: TCC applications form an organizing core, connected to foundational criticism, field-range questions, perturbation physics and dated model comparisons. Numerical proximity alone does not establish scientific equivalence. The overview cards are proposed navigation scopes; individual source questions retain separate identities.

systems: Inflationary models with canonical, noncanonical, dissipative, multifield or modified-gravity dynamics
De Sitter constructions, matter sectors and global cosmological histories
targets: Conditional duration, energy-scale and tensor bounds
Field excursion, potential restrictions and model predictions
Vacuum dynamics, relics and spacetime evolution
regimes: Source-specific cosmological phases and dimensional settings
assumptions: TCC and other quantum-gravity conjectures are conditional or contested inputs, not established laws
Different sources may test, modify or reject a proposed restriction
conventions: Field distance is distinct from fluctuation wavelength
Hubble crossing, acoustic freezeout and classicalization require separate specification
Cutoff, frame, initialization time and stochastic quantifiers remain source-specific
includes: Useful alternate homes outside the narrower TCC core
Historical proposals retained with their qualifications
excludes: A universal inflationary energy or tensor bound independent of history and fluctuation assumptions
An equivalence between TCC, distance bounds and de Sitter criteria
Current observational validation inferred from historical comparisons

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and Inflationary Cosmology

evidence.text: What restrictions on inflationary energy, primordial tensors, field range and initial conditions follow from the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture together with the requirement of causal cosmological structure formation?

sources.title: Pre-inflation and trans-Planckian censorship

evidence.text: Can a past-complete pre-inflationary history consistently supply an infinite-past Minkowski vacuum and evolve observable modes into an approximately Bunch–Davies state at inflation's beginning while respecting trans-Planckian censorship?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship, inflation, and dark matter

evidence.text: Can simple low-scale inflation satisfy the TCC and the observational constraints used in the paper, and can inflationary amplification of spectator fluctuations supply all dark matter when inflation has low H and short duration? The author does not assess TCC validity.

sources.title: Distance, de Sitter and Trans-Planckian Censorship conjectures: the status quo of Warm Inflation

evidence.text: Can canonical single-field warm inflation satisfy the distance, refined de Sitter and trans-Planckian censorship conjectures simultaneously, while reproducing the scalar spectrum, and how restrictive are the resulting small-field dynamics?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship, inflation and excited initial states for perturbations

evidence.text: Can inflation satisfying the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture produce an observable primordial tensor signal if scalar and tensor perturbations begin in independently excited states?

sources.title: Mass bound for primordial black hole from trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Assuming TCC, what mass bounds follow for primordial black holes produced at horizon reentry from enhanced small-scale inflationary curvature perturbations, in radiation domination or an early matter-dominated era, after removing explicit reheating-history dependence?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and Inflation in Grand Unified Theories

evidence.text: Can an inflation model retain a GUT-scale symmetry-breaking parameter while satisfying the low inflationary scale demanded by trans-Planckian censorship and matching the observed scalar spectrum?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship and single-field inflaton potential

evidence.text: Assuming trans-Planckian censorship for every physically possible initial condition, which smooth single-field slow-roll potentials can fit CMB data while limiting total inflation, and what follows for the energy scale, tensor amplitude, and running of the scalar spectral index?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship of multistage inflation and dark energy

evidence.text: Conditional on trans-Planckian censorship, how does primordial inflation constrain subsequent accelerated and decelerated stages, including the present dark-energy era? Can inflation occur through successive potential barriers separated by AdS vacua?

sources.title: Is the trans-Planckian censorship a swampland conjecture?

evidence.text: Can a mode initially shorter than the Planck length become a classical cosmological fluctuation? TCC prohibits this process and translates that prohibition into a bound on expansion relative to the Hubble scale.

sources.title: A refined trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can a weaker, field-space-wide refinement of TCC follow from the strong scalar weak gravity conjecture and species/entropy arguments, while relaxing inflationary fine-tuning and allowing hilltop eternal inflation?

sources.title: Initial conditions for plateau inflation: a case study

evidence.text: Does plateau inflation require finely selected homogeneous initial conditions when the inflationary scale and field values are well below the Planck scale, and how do the resulting models fare against CMB data and proposed trans-Planckian censorship bounds?

sources.title: Power Law Plateau Inflation Potential In The RS $II$ Braneworld Evading Swampland Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a modified cosmological expansion law make a single-field plateau potential observationally viable with 55–75 e-folds while meeting potential-gradient and field-range conjectures, and can selected reheating histories also meet TCC?

sources.title: Role of trans-Planckian modes in cosmology

evidence.text: Does the de Sitter swampland conjecture require the precise TCC prohibition on trans-Planckian modes crossing the Hubble radius? Can such modes classicalize inside it, and when can excited quantum fluctuations affect warm inflation?

sources.title: Thermal, trapped and chromo-natural inflation in light of the swampland criteria and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can thermal trapping or additional inflaton damping reconcile inflation with conjectural restrictions on scalar excursions and potential derivatives, and does either mechanism evade trans-Planckian censorship?

sources.title: Large $r$ against Trans-Planckian Censorship in Scalar-Tensor Theory?

evidence.text: Can nonminimal inflaton–gravity coupling modify the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture sufficiently to permit a tensor-to-scalar ratio of order 10^(−3), and what conditions on the effective Planck mass and reheating would be required?

sources.title: De Sitter quantum breaking, swampland conjectures and thermal strings

evidence.text: Can quantum-breaking censorship be related directly to TCC and its logarithmic corrections, or yield other conjectures? Can decoherence reproduce the high-temperature lifetime? Identifying the proposed topological phase and computing its thermal scaling remain direct tests of the argument.

sources.title: Brane inflation and trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: How does trans-Planckian censorship constrain RS brane inflation through the brane tension, temperature, potential, duration, slow-roll parameter and tensor-to-scalar ratio? Can a slowly varying Hubble parameter relax the severe constant-H bounds?

sources.title: Tsallis holographic dark energy for inflation

evidence.text: Can Tsallis holographic dark energy with a Granda–Oliveros cutoff drive inflation compatible with the paper's Planck-2018 comparison, admit scalar-field background correspondences, and satisfy the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture and Early Universe Cosmology

evidence.text: What does the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture imply for effective-field-theory descriptions of inflation, alternative early-universe scenarios and late-time acceleration? This paper reviews existing arguments and conditional bounds.

sources.title: On the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture and the generalized non-minimal coupling

evidence.text: How do TCC inflationary bounds behave with generic nonminimal scalar–gravity coupling in Jordan and Einstein frames, and can an initial-effective-Planck-mass prescription relax those bounds for generalized coupling correlated with a symmetry-breaking potential?

sources.title: Intermediate class of warm pseudoscalar inflation

evidence.text: Can intermediate expansion in warm pseudoscalar inflation with approximately constant, large dissipation yield parameters compatible with the paper's CMB comparison and the conjectural swampland and Trans-Planckian censorship criteria?

sources.title: Minimal warm inflation and TCC

evidence.text: Does minimal warm inflation with a hybrid-form potential have parameter space compatible with Planck 2018 CMB data and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture, when its model-specific primordial spectrum is fitted directly?

sources.title: Wave function of the universe in the presence of trans-Planckian censorship

evidence.text: Can a phenomenological modification of the Lorentzian minisuperspace path integral encode trans-Planckian censorship in a closed de Sitter universe's wave function, and what consequences follow for its final Hubble rate and tensor perturbations?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and Spacetime Singularities

evidence.text: What do trans-Planckian censorship bounds imply about scale-factor blowup, infinite proper-time evolution and spacetime geodesic completeness, and which additional analytic and causal hypotheses are required?

sources.title: TCC bounds on the static patch of de Sitter space

evidence.text: Does describing Gibbons-Hawking particles as localized wave packets, together with a near-horizon UV cutoff, produce a time limit on the static-patch EFT description matching the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship constraints on properties and cosmological applications of axion-like fields

evidence.text: What bounds does the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture impose on identical cosine-potential axions, and can these fields consistently drive inflation or quintessence?

sources.title: The role of torsion in trans-Planckian physics

evidence.text: Can spin-sourced torsion, treated as a trans-Planckian effect in Einstein–Cartan cosmology, alter inflationary scalar and tensor spectra through a finite-time vacuum prescription and yield parameters compatible with the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture?

sources.title: A power-law inflation tail for the standard R2-inflation and the Trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can a constant-EoS scalar-driven power-law tail reconcile R² slow-roll inflation with the Trans-Planckian censorship conjecture (TCC) and de Sitter swampland slope criterion, while retaining acceptable CMB predictions?

sources.title: Cosmological constraints from UV/IR mixing

evidence.text: Can entropy-motivated relations between ultraviolet and infrared cutoffs constrain the complete field excursion and duration of inflation, and connect primordial tensor observables to the number of extra dimensions?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and Inflationary Cosmology

evidence.text: Construct an inverted-parabola potential over a narrow interval, relate η to the scalar tilt, and derive trajectory constraints. The authors additionally report a numerical test of TCC consistency for every expansionary trajectory in their specified example.

sources.title: Pre-inflation and trans-Planckian censorship

evidence.text: Solve the Mukhanov–Sasaki equation using Hankel functions for piecewise z ∝ (τR,j−τ)^nj, with νj = |nj−1/2|. Match uk and u′k across adjacent phases and multiply transfer matrices; use large-argument asymptotics to estimate Bogoliubov mixing.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship, inflation, and dark matter

evidence.text: Combine the TCC upper duration restriction with the horizon-problem lower restriction. Entropy conservation, thermal degrees of freedom, instantaneous reheating, and the slow-roll Friedmann equation convert these restrictions into energy and tensor bounds.

sources.title: Distance, de Sitter and Trans-Planckian Censorship conjectures: the status quo of Warm Inflation

evidence.text: For warm inflation, uses an imported strong-dissipation scalar spectrum, an unchanged tensor spectrum, and the approximate tilt ns−1≈3(−3εφ+2ηφ−3βφ)/(4Q). A quoted warm field-excursion relation is then used to assess the distance criterion. These calculations are reported, not independently reproduced here.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship, inflation and excited initial states for perturbations

evidence.text: Constrain excitation amplitudes using the stronger backreaction condition |β₀|≲sqrt(ε|η′|) H_inf M_Pl/M², then estimate scalar and tensor bispectra in squeezed and flattened configurations using formulas imported from earlier work.

sources.title: Mass bound for primordial black hole from trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: The calculation combines horizon matching aform Hform=aPBH HPBH with fluid scaling H∝a^[−3(1+w)/2], then translates the formation Hubble scale into a horizon-collapse mass.

sources.title: de Sitter Bubbles and the Swampland

evidence.text: Could a trans-Planckian change in field position alter the light degrees of freedom enough to prevent a slow Hawking–Moss transition from transmitting the TCC concern to the next vacuum?

sources.title: A (Strictly) Contemporary Perspective on Trans-Planckian Censorship

evidence.text: Can ultraviolet modes outside a cosmological EFT's initial domain later acquire classically relevant wavelengths? The TCC conjecturally forbids the stretching history that would produce such trans-Hubble descendants.

sources.title: de Sitter Complementarity, TCC, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the coincidence between the TCC maximum de Sitter lifetime and the proposed scrambling time yield a thermodynamic interpretation of TCC, and what would that imply for inflationary initial conditions?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can censoring the classical emergence of trans-Planckian fluctuations provide a quantum-gravity principle yielding de Sitter-type restrictions at large field distance and definite constraints at finite field range?

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: What energy-scale requirement connects inflation to an SDC-induced cutoff? The authors require H ≤ Λ_QG so that the Hubble scale used in the inflationary description does not exceed the quantum-gravity cutoff.

sources.title: On thermalization in de Sitter space

evidence.text: How long can nonthermal deviations from the Bunch–Davies state survive in de Sitter space, and can pre-inflationary information persist long enough to affect the CMB? How does this relaxation time differ from recurrence times in finite isolated systems?

sources.title: The species scale and the refined TCC bounds

evidence.text: How does replacing the Planck cutoff by an evolving species cutoff modify trans-Planckian censorship, de Sitter bounds, cosmological singularities, and constraints on the species-scale slope?

sources.title: Non‐Standard Cosmological Models and The Trans‐Planckian Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: How strongly can nonthermal post-inflationary evolution or additional inflationary stages relax the TCC upper bound on the Hubble scale of the inflation responsible for observed CMB perturbations?

sources.title: The Trans-Planckian problem in Tachyacoustic Cosmology

evidence.text: Can power-law tachyacoustic cosmology generate the observed, normalized primordial spectrum and solve the horizon problem while keeping the Hubble scale and pressure below Planckian values and the fluctuation freezeout length above the Planck length?

sources.title: Scalar potential bounds on one-parameter Calabi-Yau threefolds with fluxes

evidence.text: How do the refined de Sitter conjecture, Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture (TCC), and species-scale bounds constrain one-parameter type IIB flux potentials, their partial extrema, and multifield cosmological evolution?

sources.title: Unitarity problems for an effective field theory description of early universe cosmology

evidence.text: What constraints follow if the modes with observationally motivated primordial origin must remain within the initial cutoff EFT Hilbert space throughout their evolution, even though the full expanding-universe EFT has the stated unitarity problem?

sources.title: Universal Upper Bound on the Inflationary Energy Scale from the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: How large can the inflationary Hubble rate and CMB tensor amplitude be under trans-Planckian censorship when immediate reheating and nearly constant Hubble expansion are relaxed, and which expansion histories saturate the resulting bound?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and $k$-inflation

evidence.text: The setting is scalar perturbation production during expanding k-inflation. Physical acoustic length cS/H, comoving acoustic length cS/(aH), and Hubble length H⁻¹ must be distinguished when comparing mode growth, freezeout and Planck-scale initial wavelengths.

sources.title: TCC in the interior of moduli space and its implications for the string landscape and cosmology

evidence.text: Can validity of EFT in a particle-free asymptotic future vacuum constrain earlier accelerated expansion, including trajectories through the interior of moduli space, and thereby provide a conditional bottom-up argument for TCC?

sources.title: A Tip for Landscape Riders: Multi-Field Inflation Can Fulfill the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Can an inflationary trajectory have a super-Planckian traversed length, sufficient for observable tensors, while its endpoints remain separated by a sub-Planckian geodesic distance? Turning also changes the perturbation spectrum, so geometry and fluctuation dynamics must be assessed together.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship conjecture in holographic cosmology

evidence.text: Assuming the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture (TCC), what constraints follow for the running couplings and accessible energy scales of field theories holographically dual to inflation?

sources.title: Thermal, trapped and chromo-natural inflation in light of the swampland criteria and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Does thermal inflation remain compatible with censorship when the potentially dangerous wavelength is initialized at the Planck time rather than at thermal inflation's onset?

sources.title: Cosmological Trans-Planckian Conjectures are not Effective

evidence.text: Does cosmological redshifting of modes through a fixed ultraviolet cutoff necessarily destroy late-time EFT predictions, and does established EFT reasoning require a trans-Planckian censorship restriction?

sources.title: Perturbation spectrum in inflation with cutoff

evidence.text: How does a minimum-length ultraviolet cutoff implemented through modified commutation relations affect the scale dependence, normalization, and Gaussianity of inflationary perturbations, particularly as the cutoff approaches the Hubble scale?

sources.title: Non-perpetual eternal inflation and the emergent de Sitter Swampland conjecture

evidence.text: Can generalized eternal-inflation thresholds relate the primordial tilt to a minimum total inflationary duration, constrain inflation models using CMB data, and connect eternal inflation with the refined de Sitter conjecture?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Issues for Inflationary Cosmology

evidence.text: Are inflationary fluctuation predictions robust when observable modes originate below the Planck length, and could cosmological observations reveal the intervening high-energy physics?

sources.title: Small-Field and Scale-Free: Inflation and Ekpyrosis at their Extremes

evidence.text: Can inflationary expansion or ekpyrotic smoothing and perturbation generation fit inside a Planck-sized scalar-field interval when the equation of state follows a power law over the required cosmological duration?

sources.title: Inflationary Cosmology with Quantum Gravitational Effects and Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: How can ultraviolet modifications of the propagation of scalar and tensor inflationary modes alter their primordial power while returning to linear dispersion at low physical momentum?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship conjecture from the swampland distance conjecture

evidence.text: How much expansion can occur before an initially Planck-scale wavelength reaches the Hubble radius? The TCC treats the avoidance of this crossing as a requirement on a cosmological EFT.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship conjecture from the swampland distance conjecture

evidence.text: Does the emergence of light states at large scalar-field distance constrain cosmological expansion strongly enough to prevent initially trans-Planckian fluctuations from crossing the Hubble horizon?

sources.title: A remedy of the trans-Planckian censorship problem with smooth slow-roll to power-law inflation transitions in scalar field theory

evidence.text: Can one scalar field smoothly connect a short slow-roll epoch to power-law inflation, retain acceptable slow-roll observables and implement the proposed power-law-tail remedy for trans-Planckian censorship?

sources.title: A (Strictly) Contemporary Perspective on Trans-Planckian Censorship

evidence.text: Which parts of trans-Planckian censorship follow from contemporary treatments of quantum fields and classical gravity, and which require an additional claim about unknown ultraviolet quantum gravity?

sources.title: Classical and Stochastic Trans-Planckian Censorship

evidence.text: How should the TCC constrain stochastic inflationary durations, and when do worldline, region and reheated-volume readings strengthen or relax the classical condition, especially near eternal inflation, false vacua and quantum wells?

sources.title: Comments on the Transplanckian Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: Can quantum gravity permit an accelerated phase long enough to stretch an initially Planck-length mode beyond the Hubble scale? The paper uses this conjectural prohibition as a lifetime criterion, without committing to its validity.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship and other swampland bothers addressed in warm inflation

evidence.text: How does the conjectural trans-Planckian censorship constraint restrict warm inflation, and can two inflationary stages separated by radiation domination relax energy and tensor bounds while accommodating other swampland criteria?

sources.title: Reconciliation of High Energy Scale Models of Inflation with Planck

evidence.text: Can excited initial states for inflationary perturbations suppress the tensor-to-scalar ratio of high-scale inflation, especially V=m²φ²/2, while satisfying backreaction, spectral-tilt and non-Gaussianity constraints from the Planck data used by the paper?

sources.title: TransPlanckian Censorship on Dark Dimension Inflation

evidence.text: How does imposing the TransPlanckian Censorship Conjecture constrain dark-dimension inflation when nearly scale-invariant perturbations, the horizon problem, compactification and reheating must be accommodated simultaneously?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Censorship and $k$-inflation

evidence.text: How should trans-Planckian censorship be imposed when scalar fluctuations freeze at an acoustic horizon? The paper asks how this changes the allowed duration, Hubble scale and tensor signal of inflation, with a power-law DBI application.

sources.title: Consistency of Cubic Galileon Cosmology: Model-Independent Bounds from Background Expansion and Perturbative Analyses

evidence.text: Can accelerated expansion persist without promoting initially trans-Planckian wavelengths to super-Hubble scales? The TCC answers this conjecturally by constraining expansion between specified times, rather than solely excluding a constant-Hubble endpoint.

sources.title: The entropic quasi-de Sitter instability time from the distance conjecture

evidence.text: Must an accelerating phase end before an initially sub-Planckian wavelength can stretch beyond the Hubble radius?

sources.title: Thermal, trapped and chromo-natural inflation in light of the swampland criteria and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can expansion promote an initially Planckian wavelength beyond the Hubble radius, making large-scale cosmological predictions sensitive to trans-Planckian modes?

sources.title: Relaxing the TCC Bound on Inflationary Cosmology?

evidence.text: How far can TCC bounds on inflationary energy and primordial tensors be relaxed by allowing substantial potential-energy evolution after observable modes exit, while preserving the initial nearly scale-invariant scalar spectrum?

sources.title: The Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture in different frameworks of viable inflation

evidence.text: Under what conditions can observationally viable inflation satisfy the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture (TCC), and how do its constraints on gravitational waves and initial conditions change between canonical slow-roll, modified-gravity slow-roll, and constant-roll models?

sources.title: de Sitter Vacua in the String Landscape: La Petite Version

evidence.text: Does trans-Planckian censorship constrain the evolving de Sitter construction, and does its proposed trans-Planckian motivation apply in string theory? The review explicitly leaves the precise relationship unresolved.

sources.title: A (Strictly) Contemporary Perspective on Trans-Planckian Censorship

evidence.text: Does a carefully specified version of cosmic censorship illuminate the proposed relation between ultraviolet quantum processes and classical cosmological behavior? The paper leaves this as an open comparative research question.

sources.title: Trans-Planckian Philosophy of Cosmology

evidence.text: How can trans-Planckian censorship make the asserted autonomy of early-universe structure formation from quantum gravity into an empirical constraint on quantum-gravity research, including approaches beyond string theory?

sources.title: (Quasi-) de Sitter solutions across dimensions and the TCC bound

evidence.text: Can scalar fluctuations or three-dimensional source sectors sustain the TCC argument when the usual propagating gravitational fluctuations are absent?

sources.title: Breathing comoving Hubble: Initial condition and eternity in view of the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can multiple inflationary stages obey the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture while allowing high-scale observable inflation, preparing its initial smooth patch, explaining the present horizon, and accommodating eternal inflation?

sources.title: Inflation and Decoupling

evidence.text: Does tracing inflationary perturbations backward to sub-Planckian wavelengths invalidate low-energy inflation after a logarithmic number of e-folds, or is that proposed bound incompatible with ordinary heavy-mode decoupling?

sources.title: Strengthening the TCC Bound on Inflationary Cosmology

evidence.text: How does an expanding radiation-dominated era between the Planck time and inflation strengthen TCC bounds on inflationary energy and primordial tensors, once late matter domination is included?

sources.title: Solving the trans-Planckian censorship problem with a power-law tail in <math altimg="si1.svg"><msup><mi>R</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> inflation: A dynamical system approach

evidence.text: Can an R²-corrected scalar theory dynamically transition from quasi-de Sitter inflation to an exponential-potential power-law tail proposed to address trans-Planckian censorship? If the combined system cannot realize that tail, what modification and exit mechanism could permit it?

Does the de Sitter swampland conjecture require the precise TCC prohibition on trans-Planckian modes crossing the Hubble radius? Can such modes classicalize inside it, and when can excited quantum fluctuations affect warm inflation?

Can thermal trapping or additional inflaton damping reconcile inflation with conjectural restrictions on scalar excursions and potential derivatives, and does either mechanism evade trans-Planckian censorship?

Can nonminimal inflaton–gravity coupling modify the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture sufficiently to permit a tensor-to-scalar ratio of order 10^(−3), and what conditions on the effective Planck mass and reheating would be required?

Can quantum-breaking censorship be related directly to TCC and its logarithmic corrections, or yield other conjectures? Can decoherence reproduce the high-temperature lifetime? Identifying the proposed topological phase and computing its thermal scaling remain direct tests of the argument.

How does trans-Planckian censorship constrain RS brane inflation through the brane tension, temperature, potential, duration, slow-roll parameter and tensor-to-scalar ratio? Can a slowly varying Hubble parameter relax the severe constant-H bounds?

Can Tsallis holographic dark energy with a Granda–Oliveros cutoff drive inflation compatible with the paper's Planck-2018 comparison, admit scalar-field background correspondences, and satisfy the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture?

What does the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture imply for effective-field-theory descriptions of inflation, alternative early-universe scenarios and late-time acceleration? This paper reviews existing arguments and conditional bounds.

How do TCC inflationary bounds behave with generic nonminimal scalar–gravity coupling in Jordan and Einstein frames, and can an initial-effective-Planck-mass prescription relax those bounds for generalized coupling correlated with a symmetry-breaking potential?

Can intermediate expansion in warm pseudoscalar inflation with approximately constant, large dissipation yield parameters compatible with the paper's CMB comparison and the conjectural swampland and Trans-Planckian censorship criteria?

Does minimal warm inflation with a hybrid-form potential have parameter space compatible with Planck 2018 CMB data and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture, when its model-specific primordial spectrum is fitted directly?

Can a phenomenological modification of the Lorentzian minisuperspace path integral encode trans-Planckian censorship in a closed de Sitter universe's wave function, and what consequences follow for its final Hubble rate and tensor perturbations?

What do trans-Planckian censorship bounds imply about scale-factor blowup, infinite proper-time evolution and spacetime geodesic completeness, and which additional analytic and causal hypotheses are required?

Does describing Gibbons-Hawking particles as localized wave packets, together with a near-horizon UV cutoff, produce a time limit on the static-patch EFT description matching the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture?
What bounds does the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture impose on identical cosine-potential axions, and can these fields consistently drive inflation or quintessence?

Can spin-sourced torsion, treated as a trans-Planckian effect in Einstein–Cartan cosmology, alter inflationary scalar and tensor spectra through a finite-time vacuum prescription and yield parameters compatible with the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture?

Can a constant-EoS scalar-driven power-law tail reconcile R² slow-roll inflation with the Trans-Planckian censorship conjecture (TCC) and de Sitter swampland slope criterion, while retaining acceptable CMB predictions?

Can entropy-motivated relations between ultraviolet and infrared cutoffs constrain the complete field excursion and duration of inflation, and connect primordial tensor observables to the number of extra dimensions?

Can an R²-corrected scalar theory dynamically transition from quasi-de Sitter inflation to an exponential-potential power-law tail proposed to address trans-Planckian censorship? If the combined system cannot realize that tail, what modification and exit mechanism could permit it?
How does replacing the Planck cutoff by an evolving species cutoff modify trans-Planckian censorship, de Sitter bounds, cosmological singularities, and constraints on the species-scale slope?

Can one scalar field smoothly connect a short slow-roll epoch to power-law inflation, retain acceptable slow-roll observables and implement the proposed power-law-tail remedy for trans-Planckian censorship?

How do the refined de Sitter conjecture, Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture (TCC), and species-scale bounds constrain one-parameter type IIB flux potentials, their partial extrema, and multifield cosmological evolution?
